title: Reserve a service with a logged-in customer
description: An authenticated customer can choose a future date and available time slot, confirm the reservation, and see the success confirmation with the WhatsApp action.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Click the reserve action for a service
Verify a booking success confirmation is visible
Verify a WhatsApp confirmation action is available

title: Explorar a vitrine inicial e abrir uma barbearia
description: Verifica que o visitante vê a vitrine inicial com destaque e consegue abrir uma barbearia a partir da home.

steps.description: Verify the welcome heading and the current date are visible
Verify the barbershop detail page is displayed

title: Start booking from a service while logged out

steps.description: Click the reserve action for a service
Verify the sign-in dialog is visible
Verify the barbershop page is still visible

title: See login required message on bookings page

steps.description: Verify a login required message is visible
Verify the bookings dashboard content is not shown

title: Buscar barbearias por nome
description: Verifica que a busca na listagem encontra barbearias correspondentes ao termo digitado.

steps.description: Fill in the search field with a valid barbershop name
Verify the results header reflects the search

title: Open a barbershop detail page and review its information

title: Abrir a página de detalhes e ler serviços, horários e contato

steps.description: Verify the services list is displayed
Verify the opening hours and contact information are displayed

Verify the not-found page is displayed

title: Admin login lands on the dashboard
description: An authenticated barber admin signs in through /login and is redirected to /dashboard with greeting and metric cards.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Wait for the redirect after login
Verify the URL contains /dashboard and the greeting 'Olá, Admin!' is visible
Verify the metric cards 'Agendamentos', 'Faturamento previsto', 'Concluídos' and 'Faltas e cancelamentos' are displayed
Verify the section heading 'Atendimentos do dia' is visible

title: Navigate between days on the admin dashboard
description: The admin moves to the next day with the day navigator, sees the day view, and returns to today with the 'Hoje' button.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify today's greeting 'Olá, Admin!' is visible
Verify the page eyebrow changes to 'Visão do dia' (not today anymore)
Verify the greeting returns to 'Olá, Admin!' for today's view

title: See today's appointment with status actions
description: The dashboard agenda lists today's seeded booking with its status badge and the available attendance actions.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify a booking row for the service 'Corte de Cabelo' at 18:30 is listed under 'Atendimentos do dia'
Verify the booking row shows the status badge 'Confirmado'
Verify the action buttons 'Concluir', 'Faltou' and 'Cancelar' are visible for the confirmed booking (do not click them)

title: View the schedule page timeline
description: The Agenda page shows the calendar, the block manager and the day timeline containing today's booking.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the heading 'Gestão de horários' is visible
Verify the month calendar is displayed
Verify the 'Bloqueios do dia' card with the 'Bloquear' button is visible
Verify the timeline lists the 18:30 'Corte de Cabelo' booking with the customer name

title: Create and remove a schedule block
description: The admin blocks the lunch hour on today's schedule with a preset and then removes the block, leaving the day clean.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the dialog 'Bloquear horário' opens for today's date
Verify the start time is 12:00 and the end time is 13:00
Verify the success toast 'Horário bloqueado.' appears
Verify the 12:00 – 13:00 block card is now listed under 'Bloqueios do dia'
Click the 'Remover bloqueio' button of that block
Verify the success toast 'Bloqueio removido.' appears
Verify the empty message 'Nenhum bloqueio nesse dia.' is displayed again

title: Review the services catalog overview
description: The services page shows catalog metrics and the list of seeded services with price and duration.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the heading 'Serviços' with the eyebrow 'Catálogo' is visible
Verify the metric cards 'Ativos', 'Preço médio' and 'Duração média' are displayed
Verify the service cards include 'Corte de Cabelo' and 'Barba' with their prices
Verify the 'Novo serviço' button and the services count heading are visible

title: Create and then delete a service
description: The admin creates a new service through the dialog and removes it afterwards to leave the catalog unchanged.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Fill the name field with 'Corte Teste Sprite' and the description with 'Serviço criado pelo teste automatizado.'
Choose 30 in the duration select (Duração) and fill the image URL field with https://utfs.io/f/c97a2dc9-cf62-468b-a851-bfd2bdde775f-16p.png
Verify the success toast 'Serviço criado.' appears
Verify a new service card named 'Corte Teste Sprite' is listed
Click the delete button with aria-label 'Excluir Corte Teste Sprite'
Verify the confirmation dialog 'Excluir Corte Teste Sprite?' opens
Verify the success toast 'Serviço excluído.' appears
Verify the 'Corte Teste Sprite' card is no longer listed

title: Deactivate and reactivate a service
description: The admin toggles the active switch of a service off and back on, confirming both state-change toasts.

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
In the service card 'Sobrancelha', click the switch labeled 'Desativar serviço'
Verify the toast 'Serviço desativado.' appears and the card becomes dimmed
In the same 'Sobrancelha' card, click the switch labeled 'Ativar serviço'

title: Save the barbershop profile in settings

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Verify the section heading 'Dados da barbearia' is visible
Verify the name field is prefilled with 'Barbearia Vintage'
Verify at least one phone field and the 'Salvar dados' button are visible
Verify the success toast 'Dados da barbearia salvos.' appears

title: Save the opening hours in settings

steps.description: Fill in the login credentials with {{LOGIN_USER}} and {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Scroll down to the 'Horário de funcionamento' section
Verify weekday rows from 'Domingo' to 'Sábado' are displayed with time inputs
Verify the success toast 'Horário de funcionamento salvo.' appears
